_doc: Project 006 v2 - API Manager policy bundle for ALL Process APIs (submit-order, initiate-wire, rebalance-portfolio, run-kyc-screening, open-account, close-account). Apply the same 4 policies to each deployed CloudHub app via Anypoint API Manager UI or the platform-api REST. These policies layer on top of the MuleSoft-internal logic; they do not replace HITL (enforced upstream in the mulesoft-api skill) or audit (the Lambda writes IR_Audit_Log__c per 006 v2 steering rule 10).
_finra_context: FINRA Rule 3110 (supervision) requires access controls + rate limits on all order-entry, wire, KYC, and account-lifecycle surfaces. FINRA Rule 4511 (books and records) requires request attribution via client_id headers. These policies are the perimeter layer for every Process API; deeper controls live in Salesforce + the Lambda.

policies.name: client-id-enforcement
policies._finra_purpose: FINRA 4511 / SEC 17a-4: every order-entry request must be attributable to a named Connected App. Unattributed calls are rejected at the edge.

policies.name: rate-limiting
policies._finra_purpose: FINRA 3110 supervision: cap order-entry throughput so a runaway loop in the Lambda cannot DoS the downstream OMS. 60 req/min sits well above HITL-paced volume (1 trade per 5-10 min per advisor) but catches automation bugs fast.

policies.name: json-threat-protection
policies._finra_purpose: Defense against malformed or oversized payloads crafted to exploit the DataWeave parser. Caps match the RAML contracts across all 6 Process APIs: requests are flat (max 2 levels of nesting) and carry no free-text fields beyond the short close_account reason.

policies.name: ip-allowlist
policies._finra_purpose: Only the mulesoft-actions Lambda's NAT EIP should reach this API in sandbox. Set the real EIP via API Manager UI once the VPC stack is provisioned. Steering rule 19.
policies._note: ipExpression is a placeholder. Replace via API Manager. Zero credentials in git.
